title: A Complete Equational Presentation of Qudit Circuits via Polycontrolled PROPs
summary: High-dimensional quantum computation needs a native circuit-level equational theory for qudits. We give the first finite schematic equational theory that is sound and complete for exact unitary qudit circuits in every finite dimension at least two. Circuits are built from local gates, sequential and parallel composition, and value-controls; equality is derivable exactly when the standard unitary denotations agree.
